questions.stem: 把二氧化碳（carbon dioxide）排放到空氣中愈來愈昂貴，迫使許多工廠投資碳捕捉技術。
questions.answer: Releasing carbon dioxide into the air is becoming more and more expensive, forcing many factories to invest in carbon capture technology.
accepted_answers: It is becoming increasingly expensive to release carbon dioxide into the air, forcing many factories to invest in carbon capture technology.

關係代名詞 that／which 引導的形容詞子句

1.explanation_zh: 主詞是「把二氧化碳排放到空氣中」這個動作，英文用動名詞片語 Releasing carbon dioxide into the air，或虛主詞 It is becoming increasingly expensive to release …；「愈來愈昂貴」寫 is becoming more and more expensive。「迫使許多工廠投資碳捕捉技術」是結果，中文沒有主詞，英文用句尾分詞 , forcing many factories to invest in carbon capture technology；「投資」要寫 invest in。
evidence: 把二氧化碳（carbon dioxide）排放到空氣中
迫使許多工廠投資碳捕捉技術
1.strategy_zh: 「把…＋動詞」放在句首當主詞時，用動名詞片語；結果放句尾用 , forcing + O + to VR。
hints: 切成四段：把二氧化碳（carbon dioxide）排放到空氣中／愈來愈昂貴／迫使許多工廠／投資碳捕捉技術
標的詞彙：release（排放）、air（空氣）、expensive（昂貴的）、force（迫使）、factory（工廠）、invest（投資）、capture（捕捉）、technology（技術）
句型框架：V-ing … + is becoming more and more + adj., forcing + O + to VR …

2.explanation_zh: 「捕捉到的二氧化碳」是被捕捉的，用過去分詞 The captured carbon dioxide。「會被送往地底深處」用被動 is sent deep underground（underground 是副詞，前面不加 to），「存放在…」和它並列，同樣是被動 and stored in …。「曾經蘊藏石油或天然氣的岩層」修飾語很長，英文改成關係子句放在名詞後面：rock layers that once contained oil or natural gas，「曾經」用過去式 contained 或 used to contain。
evidence: 曾經蘊藏石油或天然氣的岩層
2.strategy_zh: 東西「被」怎麼處理時用被動 be + p.p.，兩個被動動作並列可省略第二個 be；名詞前很長的「…的」修飾語改成後位的 that／which 子句。
hints: 切成四段：捕捉到的二氧化碳（carbon dioxide）／會被送往地底深處／存放在／曾經蘊藏石油或天然氣的岩層中
標的詞彙：capture（捕捉）、send（送往）、deep（深處）、underground（地底）、store（存放）、rock（岩石）、layer（層）、once（曾經）、oil（石油）、natural（天然的）、gas（氣體）
句型框架：The p.p. + N + is sent deep underground and stored in + N + that once + V-ed …

1.notes_zh: 評分說明：「把二氧化碳排放到空氣中」releasing／emitting／discharging carbon dioxide into the air（atmosphere），或用虛主詞 It is becoming … to release …（也算達成本句 NFSUBJ 標的）；「愈來愈昂貴」is becoming／has become／is getting more and more (increasingly) expensive（costly）；「迫使」forcing／compelling／pushing／driving，寫成 , which is forcing／forces many factories to …（which 指前面整件事）也算達成本句 PART 標的；「投資碳捕捉技術」invest in carbon capture technology（technologies、technology for capturing carbon 也可以）。另外也給分：is costing more and more、costs more and more、is growing more and more expensive、is becoming ever more expensive。

1.translation: Releasing carbon dioxide into the air is becoming more and more expensive, forcing many factories to invest in carbon capture technology.
1.explanation_zh: 「把二氧化碳排放到空氣中」當主詞用動名詞 Releasing …（emitting 亦可）；「愈來愈昂貴」用 is becoming more and more expensive；「迫使」用分詞構句；「投資」用 invest in。

2.translation: The captured carbon dioxide is then sent deep underground and stored in rock layers that once held oil or natural gas.
2.explanation_zh: 「會被送往…存放在…」描述一般流程，用現在式被動 is sent … and stored；「曾經蘊藏石油或天然氣的岩層」用 that 關係子句 that once held …；「地底深處」譯 deep underground。

problems: 第 2 題驗證者說用了句型 PASS，程式在譯文裡看不出來

1.translation: Releasing carbon dioxide into the air is becoming more and more expensive, forcing many factories to invest in carbon capture technology.
1.explanation_zh: 「把二氧化碳排放到空氣中」是主詞，用動名詞片語 Releasing carbon dioxide into the air；「愈來愈昂貴」用 more and more expensive，搭配進行式 is becoming；「迫使許多工廠投資碳捕捉技術」用 forcing many factories to invest in carbon capture technology。

2.translation: The captured carbon dioxide is sent deep underground and stored in rock layers that used to contain oil or natural gas.
2.explanation_zh: 「捕捉到的二氧化碳」用過去分詞 captured 當前位修飾語；「會被送往……存放在……」用被動語態 is sent ... and stored，兩個動詞共用 is；「曾經蘊藏石油或天然氣的岩層」用 rock layers that used to contain oil or natural gas，used to 表示過去曾經如此、現在已非。
